assumption_to_test: a minimal source-integrity, signal-reconciliation, and closure model can deterministically reject correlated confirmation, unresolved conflicts, and premature closure without claiming semantic truth
smallest_testable_validation: extend the canonical ledger example and retained negative fixture suite with one complete incident and mutations for source identity, independence, conflict, window completeness, authority, and closure conditions
expected_learning: whether the model is executable, explainable, provider-neutral, and resistant to false closure
expected_cost: one bounded schema, verifier, fixture, documentation, and portable-package release slice
success_threshold: all positive packages pass, every targeted mutation fails with its expected error, portable verification passes, and AOF review finds no authority or semantic-truth overclaim
